issues.issue: Was the Officer's assessment of the Applicant's establishment in Canada reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Officer unreasonably discounted establishment as common and failed to justify this; Applicant has strong interdependent relationships and long residence.
issues.respondent_position: H&C assessment is discretionary; establishment alone does not justify exemption; evidence did not show extraordinary establishment.
issues.result_text: Court finds Officer's assessment unreasonable for discounting establishment as 'not uncommon' without justification.

issues.issue: Did the Officer fail to conduct an individualized assessment of the Applicant's particular circumstances in the H&C exemption determination?
issues.applicant_position: Officer failed to consider Applicant's particular circumstances and used an undefined 'common' standard improperly.
issues.result_text: Officer erred by failing individualized assessment and discounting establishment without justification.
